newsitem.title: FRANCE: Draft ONIC report sees higher barley stocks.
newsitem.headline: Draft ONIC report sees higher barley stocks.

text.p: French cereals office ONIC plans to raise its forecast for closing barley stocks for the end of this season to 939,000 tonnes from 905,000, grain industry sources said on Wednesday.

It is also ready to shave the forecast for July/June exports by 25,000 tonnes and edge up the figure for last year's delivered harvest in what seem relatively minor changes to a report due to be published next Wednesday.
The figures appear in a draft version of the report, which also sees a higher than anticipated carryover for wheat.
ONIC routinely declines to comment on its monthly grain forecasts before release, noting the drafts can be changed.

Industry sources said the May 12 report was expected to cut projected exports to European Union countries to 2.345 million tonnes from last month's 2.370 million, but would leave the total for world market sales unchanged at 1.5 million tonnes.
The amount of 1996 crop delivered to internal markets after on-farm consumption is pegged in the draft at 6.91 million tonnes, up from 6.885 million reported in April, they said.
Key consumption data were unchanged and included one million tonnes projected for animal feed manufacture.
The previous barley carryover stock on June 30, 1996, was 626,000 tonnes.
